description: Accounts Instagram suggests as related to a public profile (its similar-accounts list), up to 5: ID, username, full name, verified and private flags, profile picture and link. No follower counts for the related accounts. Some accounts have no related list (empty result). Unknown users 404; a failed fetch 503 (not charged). Related tools on this server, for a different need: social_instagram_highlights when you need story highlights of a public Instagram profile: highlight; social_instagram_profile when you need Public Instagram profile as a logged-out visitor sees it. Price: $0.02 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

username.description: Instagram username (with or without @) or instagram.com/<user> URL

name: social_instagram_related_profiles
title: Accounts Instagram suggests as related to a public profile
